name: Samurai Battlefield Master
body:
A battlefield master is, as the name entails, a master of the battlefield, cutting a swath of blood and death through the battlefield.

Acrobatic Resolve (Ex)

At 1st level, a battlefield master can use resolve to gain a morale bonus to Acrobatics checks equal 1/2 their class level for 1 check.

This ability modifies resolve.

Attacking Mobility (Ex)

Beginning with 1st level, a battlefield master gains Cleave as a bonus feat without having to meet the prerequisites. Additionally, a battlefield master can make 5-foot steps between attacks made during a full attack, Cleave, or similar feats. This does not apply to Whirlwind Attack. These 5-foot steps do not prevent attacks of opportunity and they can only make a number of them up to their base speed. If the battlefield master made a 5-foot step before making the first attack, it counts against that total. However, the battlefield master can use Acrobatics to avoid attacks of opportunity for these 5-foot steps. This ability replaces mount.

Deadly Blade (Ex)

At 4th level, if a battlefield master wields their katana in two hands, they add twice their Strength modifier to the damage instead of 1.5 times.

This ability replaces mounted archer.

Focused Power (Ex)

At 5th level, a battlefield master can focus their power and resolve as a swift action.

They gain a +2 morale bonus to Strength for a number of rounds equal to their Wisdom bonus. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to their Wisdom modifier. This ability replaces banner.

Rending Strike (Ex)

At 14th level, a battlefield master can let out a shout as they strike, driving their blade through their opponent’s defenses. As a swift action, the battlefield master can cause one attack made during the round to ignore any DR the target may have. The use of this ability must be declared before the attack roll is made. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to their Wisdom modifier. This ability replaces greater banner.
